company.name: Ironclad
company.shortDescription: Ironclad is a contract lifecycle management platform used by companies to handle every type of contract workflow.
company.description: Ironclad is a contracting platform that helps transform contract processes by automating workflows and approvals. Its platform also automatically identifies key terms and entities, turns contracts into code and allows users to search, tag, and manage their contracts to help legal, sales, and operations teams streamline the way they create, store, and combine contracts as intelligence assets.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round

insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $13,004,170 to $3,200,000,000, a 246.07x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.
